_readme: Curated seasonal activities within a ~3 hour drive of SF: things you can go
and do on any day inside a window, which no event feed lists.
'from' and 'to' are [month, day]. A 'to' earlier in the year than 'from'
wraps into the next year. Windows are typical timing, so every season is
marked approximate unless 'approx' is false. 'notability' (0-100) seeds the
heuristic ranker the same way it does in annual_events.json.
Descriptions give the drive from SF and anything you need to book or carry
(a permit, a fishing license) - that's the part that catches people out.

seasons.title: Gray whale migration at Point Reyes
seasons.description: Gray whales pass close to the headland southbound in January and northbound March-April, mothers with calves last. ~1.5h from SF. Weekend visits in peak season may need the park shuttle.

seasons.title: Whale watching in Monterey Bay (humpbacks, blue whales)
seasons.description: Humpbacks feed in the bay spring through fall, and blue whales are most likely in summer and early fall. Half-day boat trips from the wharf. ~2h from SF.

seasons.title: Farallon Islands wildlife cruises
seasons.description: Day-long naturalist boat trips to the Farallones for humpbacks, seabird colonies and sometimes blue whales. Leaves from the Bay; rough water, book ahead.

seasons.title: Elephant seal breeding season at Año Nuevo
seasons.description: Docent-led walks to the elephant seal colony while bulls fight and pups are born. Reservations required, and weekends sell out early. ~1.25h from SF.

seasons.title: Overwintering monarch butterflies
seasons.venue: Natural Bridges State Beach / Pacific Grove Monarch Sanctuary
seasons.description: Western monarchs cluster in eucalyptus groves for the winter. Best on a warm, sunny late morning, when they fly. Santa Cruz is ~1.5h from SF, Pacific Grove ~2h.

seasons.title: Pumpkin patches & corn mazes, Half Moon Bay
seasons.description: A string of farms along Highway 92 with pick-your-own pumpkins, corn mazes and hay rides. ~45min from SF. Weekday mornings avoid the 92 traffic.

seasons.title: Apple Hill orchards (apple picking, cider, pie)
seasons.description: Dozens of family orchards above Placerville with u-pick apples, cider donuts, pie and wineries. ~2.5h from SF. October weekends are busy.

seasons.title: U-pick apples around Sebastopol
seasons.description: Gravensteins in August, then later varieties into October, on the Sonoma County Farm Trails orchards. ~1.25h from SF.

seasons.title: U-pick organic strawberries on the coast
seasons.description: Pick strawberries on the bluffs north of Santa Cruz, with an honor-system farm stand. ~1.25h from SF along Highway 1.

seasons.title: U-pick cherries in Brentwood
seasons.description: A short, busy cherry season across Brentwood's u-pick orchards; go early in the day and early in the season. ~1.25h from SF.

seasons.title: Grape harvest & crush in Napa and Sonoma
seasons.description: Picking and crush season: harvest parties, grape stomps, crush-pad and barrel tours, winemaker dinners. ~1-1.5h from SF. Ask wineries about harvest experiences.

seasons.title: Sea urchin diving for uni, Sonoma & Mendocino coast
seasons.venue: North coast coves (Van Damme, Caspar, Salt Point)
seasons.description: Free-dive or scuba for red and purple urchins and crack them open for fresh uni. Taking the purple ones helps kelp forests recover. Needs a CA fishing license; check CDFW limits and closed areas. Calmest seas late summer-fall. ~2.5-3h from SF.

seasons.title: Wild mushroom season on the Sonoma & Mendocino coast
seasons.description: Chanterelles, porcini and more after the first good rains. Salt Point allows limited personal foraging, and guided forays run through the season. Never eat what you can't identify. ~2h from SF.

seasons.title: Coho salmon spawning run, Lagunitas Creek
seasons.venue: Leo T. Cronin Fish Viewing Area
seasons.description: Endangered coho push upstream to spawn a few days after big winter storms. Watch from the creekside trail. ~1h from SF.

seasons.title: Tule elk rut at Tomales Point
seasons.venue: Tule Elk Reserve, Pierce Point Ranch
seasons.description: Bull elk bugle and spar over harems on the Tomales Point bluffs. Easy trail with ocean on both sides. ~1.75h from SF.

seasons.title: Sandhill cranes at dusk near Lodi
seasons.venue: Woodbridge Ecological Reserve / Cosumnes River Preserve
seasons.description: Thousands of cranes fly in to roost at sunset. The reserve runs guided fly-in tours, and it pairs well with Lodi wineries. ~1.5h from SF.

seasons.title: Snow geese & winter waterfowl, Sacramento Valley refuges
seasons.description: Huge flocks of snow geese, ducks and raptors along a drive-through auto tour route, best at dawn. ~2.5h from SF.

seasons.title: Spring wildflower season
seasons.description: Poppies, lupine and more. Chimney Rock at Point Reyes, Mount Diablo and Pinnacles (~2h) are reliable bets, and the bloom depends on winter rain.

seasons.title: Bioluminescence kayaking on Tomales Bay
seasons.description: Guided night paddles where every stroke glows with plankton. Best on dark, moonless nights, so book near the new moon. ~1.5h from SF.

seasons.title: Tidepooling on morning minus tides
seasons.description: The lowest daytime tides of the year come on late-spring and summer mornings and expose anemones, sea stars and nudibranchs. Check a tide table for a negative low. ~40min from SF.

seasons.title: Dungeness crab season (crab pots, pier crabbing, crab feeds)
seasons.venue: Bodega Bay / Half Moon Bay / Pacifica Pier
seasons.description: Recreational crabbing from piers, kayaks or charter boats. The opener is sometimes delayed for whales or domoic acid, so check CDFW before you go. Needs a fishing license except on public piers.

seasons.title: Ski & snow season at Tahoe
seasons.description: Skiing, snowshoeing and sledding. ~3-4h from SF depending on I-80 chain controls, so leave early on Saturday or go midweek.

seasons.title: Fall aspen colors, Hope Valley & Carson Pass
seasons.description: The Sierra's most reliable aspen show, peaking around early-mid October. ~3.5h from SF: a long day, or pair it with Tahoe.
